changes.name: Vampiric Embrace
changes.before: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.
changes.after: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 10% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec. You receive 100% increased healing on yourself from this effect.

changes.name: Maelstrom Weapon
changes.before: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
changes.after: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a ?% chance (based on weapon speed) to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

changes.name: Mental Dexterity
changes.before: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 150% of your Intellect.
changes.after: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.

changes.name: Stormstrike
changes.before: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.
changes.after: Instantly strike for 100% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

changes.name: Soul Siphon
changes.before: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your other Affliction effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done or health drained by your Drain Life, Drain Soul, and Wrack spells by 12% per each of your Corruption, Siphon Life, and Bane of Agony effects active on the target, up to a maximum increase of 36%.

changes.name: Wrack
changes.before: Tears the target apart from within, inflicting 36 Shadow damage every 1 sec and increasing the damage they take from your other Shadow damage over time effects by 10% for 6 sec.
changes.after: Tears the target apart from within for 6 sec, inflicting 25.2 Shadow damage every 1 sec. While channeling, your Siphon Life, Corruption, and Bane of Agony effects on the target deal their periodic damage 100% faster.

changes.name: Swiftmend
changes.before: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of the consumed spell.
changes.after: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect.

changes.name: Gore Drinker
changes.before: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.
changes.after: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, Reckless Swings, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

changes.name: Defiance
changes.before: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 15% while a shield is equipped.
changes.after: Increases all threat generated in Defensive stance by an additional 20% while a shield is equipped.

changes.name: Rend and Tear
changes.before: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 10%.
changes.after: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 15%.

changes.name: Barrage
changes.before: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 10%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.

changes.name: Lightning Reflexes
changes.before: Increases your Agility by 10%.
changes.after: Increases your Agility by 15%.

changes.name: Sniper Shot
changes.before: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
changes.after: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

changes.name: Trueshot Aura
changes.before: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 15.
changes.after: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

changes.name: Arctic Reach

changes.after: Increases the range of your Frostbolt, Ice Lance, and Blizzard spells and the radius of your Frost Nova and Cone of Cold spells by 20%.

changes.name: Improved Frostbolt
changes.before: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt and Frost Blast spells by 0.5 sec.
changes.after: Reduces the casting time of your Frostbolt spell by 0.5 sec.

changes.name: Missile Barrage
changes.before: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.
changes.after: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

changes.name: Winter's Chill
changes.before: Gives your Frostbolt, Frost Blast, and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.
changes.after: Gives your Frostbolt and Fingers of Frost empowered Ice Lance spells a 100% chance to apply Winter's Chill, increasing the target's damage taken from your next Cone of Cold by 20% and it gains an additional 7% of your spell damage, stacking up to 5 times.

changes.before: Increases the physical damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.
changes.after: Increases the Physical and Holy damage you deal by 6%, and reduces all threat you generate by 20% while a two-handed melee weapon is equipped.

changes.name: Vengeance
changes.before: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.
changes.after: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.

changes.name: Adrenaline Rush
changes.before: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.
changes.after: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

changes.name: Blood Splatter
changes.before: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

changes.after: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

changes.name: Camouflage
changes.before: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.
changes.after: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.

changes.after: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by 10.

changes.before: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.

changes.after:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
1 point : ?% stored, ? damage cap 2 points: ?% stored, ? damage cap 3 points: ?% stored, ? damage cap 4 points: ?% stored, ? damage cap 5 points: ?% stored, ? damage cap

changes.after: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

changes.before: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.
changes.after: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.

changes.name: Dual Wield Specialization
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.

changes.name: Efficient Strikes
changes.before: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 5.

changes.name: Elusiveness
changes.before: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.

changes.name: Flash of Steel

changes.after: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 15 and reduces its cooldown by 2.0 sec.

changes.name: Flawless Execution
changes.before: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.
changes.after: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.

changes.before: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.
changes.after: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.

changes.name: Heightened Senses
changes.before: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.
changes.after: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 4%.

changes.name: Hemorrhage

changes.after: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

changes.name: Improved Ambush
changes.before: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.

changes.name: Improved Distract
changes.before: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 5 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 2 levels lower.

changes.name: Improved Expose Armor
changes.before: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.
changes.after: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

changes.before: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.
changes.after: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

changes.name: Lethality
changes.before: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 20%.

changes.before: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17.25 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.
changes.after: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 39.6 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

changes.name: Opportunity
changes.before: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.
changes.after: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 20%.

changes.name: Premeditation
changes.before: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.
changes.after: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

changes.name: Quick Getaway
changes.before: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health.
changes.after: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

changes.name: Relentless Strikes
changes.after: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

changes.before: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
changes.after: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

changes.after: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.

changes.after: Gives you a 45% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

changes.name: Venom
changes.before:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec
changes.after: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

changes.name: Vigor
changes.before: Increases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets.
changes.after: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.

changes.name: Weapon Expertise
changes.before: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.
changes.after: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.

changes.name: Call of Flame

changes.after: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 15%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 9 sec.

changes.name: Call of Thunder
changes.before: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 123 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 5%.

changes.name: Convection
changes.before: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.
changes.after: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by 10%.

changes.before: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.
changes.after: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.50 sec.

changes.after: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fire Nova spells by 6 yards.

changes.before: Gives your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
changes.after: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

changes.name: Flurry
changes.before: Increases your attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
changes.after: Increases your attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

changes.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
changes.before: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.
changes.after: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

changes.name: Improved Lightning Shield
changes.before: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.
changes.after: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.

changes.before: Gain mastery over Fire and Lightning, reducing the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from Chain Lightning. Lasts 15 sec.
changes.after: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

changes.before: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 10% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.
changes.after: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

changes.name: Mental Dexterity
changes.before: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.
changes.after: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 150% of your Intellect.

changes.after: Heals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

changes.before: Instantly strike for normal weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.
changes.after: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

changes.before: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.
changes.after: Gives you a 30% chance to deal 10% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

changes.name: Flurry
changes.before: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
changes.after: Increases your melee attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

changes.before: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

changes.after: A brutal attack that deals 75% weapon damage. Deals an additional 75% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.
